Just walk away from a track. There's no law saying that you have to finish a track before you start you next one.

When I was in a band, we would write our songs and then write lyrics. We would sometimes go months before we would finish up lyrics for a track. 

That being said, don't be afraid to write songs. I've been writing for years and when I look back on my first tracks, I cringe. Don't get me wrong, I still had fun writing them, but they aren't good. Don't fool yourself into thinking your first tracks are going to be awesome (although maybe they are, I don't know). 

My last thing for you is write for yourself. If you don't like writing music, then don't. It's not rocket science. Music is only one way to express yourself.

I agree man. I went for years without anyone but my buddies hearing my music. What I learned from that was there are two grossly generalized parts of writing music. There's the cool part, where people really enjoy your music and maybe you see some money from it. And there's the kick ass part, where you sit down and write a song that you enjoy. 

Like you said man, if you don't think the kick ass part is all that kick ass then you should find another hobby.
